## Summary

I implemented the `ticket_create` tool in `server.mjs`, replacing the previous stub. Key design points aligned with the `mcp-builder` skill:

**`listTools()`** advertises a single discoverable tool `ticket_create` with an explicit input schema including `"additionalProperties": false` (strict argument contract), `required: ["title", "description"]`, and a `priority` enum of `low/normal/high`.

**`callTool(name, args)`**:
- **Unknown tools reject** — throws `Unknown tool: <name>` (the `protocol.mjs` wrapper converts thrown errors into JSON-RPC errors).
- **Strict arg checking** — rejects non-object args and any unknown keys (no extra fields allowed).
- **Required non-empty `title`/`description`** — validated with a non-empty-string check (whitespace-only rejected too).
- **Optional `priority`** — defaults to `normal`; rejects any value outside the enum.
- **Stable sequential ids** — a module-level counter produces `t1`, `t2`, …
- **Concise text result** — returns `{content:[{type:'text', text:'Created ticket t1: "Bug" (normal priority)'}]}`.

Verified manually that id sequence increments, defaults work, and every invalid case (unknown tool, missing/empty title/description, bad priority, extra fields) throws. The full suite (`node --test`) passes: 1 pass, 0 fail.
